title: Pokój — cisza
description: Statyczny szeroki plan taniego pokoju w Belen nocą. Van śpi niespokojnie, zakamuflowana K20 leży na stoliku na pierwszym planie. Trzy sekundy ciszy i bezruchu przed wtargnięciem.

prompts.image: Exact edit of revision 1: preserve the complete room shot and reduce only the K20 on the table to canonical size, exactly 3.0 cm vertex-to-vertex and about 2.5 cm face-to-face, slightly larger than a normal tabletop D20. Keep exact position, material, numerals, contact shadow and no glow.
prompts.animation: One continuous 3-second static shot. Van breathes slowly in sleep, the curtain and humid night air barely move, and a faint corridor shadow passes under the closed door. The small canonical 3 cm K20 remains completely still and dark. Preserve identity, anatomy, room layout, prop scale and numerals. No new people, magic, morphing, cuts, captions, logos or watermark.
